源自303 與 cheo ("澆下"之意); 陰性名詞

欽定本 - excess 1; 1

1) 巨流, 過度, 沒有節制 (#彼前4:4|)
record.edic_text:
401 anachusis {an-akh'-oo-sis}

from a comparative of 303 and cheo (to pour);; n f

AV - excess 1; 1

1) an overflowing, a pouring out
2) metaph. the excess (flood) of riot in which a dissolute life
   pours itself forth

same.cexp: 倒出；漏掉；流（血）；處死；＜被＞掉進
使混亂或困惑；煽動＜被＞困惑；暴動
